confidence_interval.method: paired percentile bootstrap within original domain/difficulty strata
confidence_interval.scope: question sampling only; does not estimate model or judge rerun variance

representative_case_selection.tie_break: case_id lexical order; last for maximum

failure_policy: A complete report requires all 180 answers and 540 valid criterion evaluations; failures and retries retained. Missing grades are not scored zero.
billing: ChatGPT subscription usage only; no USD API cost inferred
